name: BEST S.a.
summary: BEST S.A. is a Polish company primarily engaged in the debt recovery sector. It delivers extensive debt collection solutions to a wide array of clients, including financial institutions such as banks and lending firms, as well as telecommunications and energy suppliers, and other large-scale service organizations. The company also oversees the securitized assets of various securitization funds and actively acquires portfolios of distressed debt through the issuance of investment certificates and bonds. Additionally, BEST S.A. offers specialized legal opinions, advisory services, and manages the investigation and enforcement of debt-related obligations. Founded in 1994, the firm is headquartered in Gdynia, Poland.
